title: Crash when creating large number of Node2D objects
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 dev 3 and earlier: No errors/crash
4.4 dev 4 - dev 7: Thousands of errors, no crash
4.4 beta 1 and later: Crash

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads)

### Issue description

Creating a large number of Node2D objects (around 250,000 - 300,000) causes a crash:

```gdscript
extends Node2D

func _ready() -> void:
	print("Start")
	for i in 300000:
		add_child(Node2D.new())
	print(get_children().size())
	print("End")
```

Before crashing, 2 errors are printed out:

```
ERROR: Element limit reached.
   at: (C:\dev\godot\core/templates/rid_owner.h:132)
ERROR: Parameter "mem" is null.
   at: RID_Alloc<struct RendererCanvasCull::Item,1>::initialize_rid (C:\dev\godot\core/templates/rid_owner.h:275)
```
